title: Do Antibiotics Cure a Cold? (No, Here's Why)
description:
Colds are caused by viruses, and antibiotics only work on bacteria. A 2025 Cochrane review found people given antibiotics for colds did no better than placebo, and adults had more side effects. Misuse drives antimicrobial resistance (WHO).

Sources:
• Kenealy T, Arroll B. Antibiotics for the common cold. Cochrane 2025: https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/41277585/
• CDC: Common cold: https://www.cdc.gov/common-cold/about/index.html
• WHO fact sheet: Antimicrobial resistance: https://www.who.int/news-room/fact-sheets/detail/antimicrobial-resistance
